received_works.body: いつもありがとうございます。今回は特に具体的な構図は考えていませんが、サイクロプス系の女の子に興味をお持ちのようですので、私のキャラクターを描いていただけると大変嬉しいです。クローバー：元気いっぱいの性格のサイクロプス系女の子。恋愛運に恵まれず、付き合う男性は必ず別れを告げてしまう。ただし、それは彼女が甘えん坊で甘やかされるのが好きなだけかもしれない。 片目からビームを放つ能力を持つ。過去の依頼で描いたパンドラ、ヒナ、ドルチェと友達。https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/138SWIhSvKSfxRDMgAbHMwpLz7ZUlarJ9?usp=drive_link 詳細は全てお任せします。よろしくお願いいたします！

こんにちは、前回のコミッション（https://skeb.jp/@Aiaeaeaia/works/11）の続編を依頼したいです。今回はスカーレット姉妹が主人公です。彼女たちは新たに手に入れた下半身を探索し、それに慣れる過程を描いてください。
背景：レミリアの下半身は巨大な木製テーブル（3m×3m×0.8m）に変化した。どうやらユカリのミスで、レミリアは自力で動けなくなった。上半身はテーブル中央上部に取り付けられている。フランの下半身はキリンに変化。キリン部分は首から始まるため、フランの身長はほぼ5m。
咲夜の下半身は牛となる。毎日自ら搾乳しなければ牛の乳房が不快になる。脚には厚手の黒ストッキング、蹄にはハイヒールを装着。物語：朝、咲夜は屋敷の他のメイドたちに下半身の搾乳と搾乳した牛乳を使った朝食の準備を依頼する。レミリアが自分の牛乳を飲むと思うと、咲夜は非常に恥ずかしく興奮し、それがさらに多くの牛乳を分泌させる。
レミリアは新たな身体に慣れつつある。テーブル脚には白いレースのストッキングを履いている。咲夜はレミリアのテーブルに紅茶を置き、丁寧に拭き上げる。その後、咲夜はレミリアを牛の背中に乗せ、歩行を補助する。レミリアは日傘を手に、上半身でバランスを取ろうとする。
フランは背が高すぎて部屋に居られない。咲夜とレミリアが外に出るのを見て、フランは二人に歩み寄る。しかしフランはつまずき、二人に倒れかかる。咲夜は避けようとするが、レミリアが背から落下。フランはレミリアの上半身にぶつかり、テーブルの脚を一本折ってしまった。以下のストーリーを3～4ページで構成してください。

いつもありがとうございます。
もし気が向きましたら私のオリキャラのイラストを描いていただければと思います。
うちの子であれば誰でも構いません、シチュエーションや構図も全てお任せします。
NSFWを有効にしていますが、自由に描いていただくために表現を制限しないようにという意図であり所望という意味ではありません。
好きなように描いていただければ幸いです。

Hello, I'm resending the request, thank you for the extended text limit. I didn't realise that I had accidentally cut off most of the original text in my request, I apologise for the inconvenience.

I've increased the payment since the previous submission, but please feel free to request a resubmission if you think it's not enough.

Thank you for the previous Touhou comics you've drawn. This time I'd like to request a transformation comic with two original characters. I've tried to be as detailed as possible with my instructions, but I'd like you to reinterpret it as much as you like.

Reference:
https://files.catbox.moe/1umnst.png
This reference image includes a past scenario involving pregnancy elements, but I'm including it purely as a visual reference for the characters. The transformation is unrelated to this request. 

The scenario for this story involves a exorcist duo, a teacher and their student. The teacher has a calm, proud personality, and is stern with her student. The teacher is used to being transformed as part of her job, and has returned to her normal human state many times before. Her student has a shy, clumsy personality, and panics easily in a high stress situation. 

Because this comic focuses on the transformations, it's okay to depict the two's original pre-transformation appearance as a simple bust shot. I would like the transformation to be depicted in three stages, all additional drawings are up to you.

In this comic, the two have entered a corrupted zone in order to find and destroy a cursed artifact. The longer the two stay there and the closer they get to it, the more they're transformed. Eventually, the student becomes susceptible to mental corruption.  After the two find the object and destroy it, the teacher is able to quickly undo her own transformation, but the student lacks the necessary ability to do the same, and as punishment for slacking off on her training, she is to be left in her monstrous form for the time being.

I'm happy to leave the details of the transformations up to you beyond what is specified, as I enjoy being surprised and always enjoy your designs. My one request is that the student maintains a cute appearance to their face even after being transformed.

The full outline, assuming one page per stage of transformation:

The two enter the zone, and immediately start to be corrupted and transformed. The teacher is able to minimise the initial changes to her body,  instead growing horns or antannae, extra eyes, and showing changes to their arms and legs, but retaining her basic humanoid shape of two arms and two legs. The student, who lacks the experience to halt the changes,  begins to change rapidly, gaining a more monstrous appearance as she begins to lose her normal humanoid shape. 

The student panics, and her teacher says that she needs to get used to transforming this much if she's going to be an exorcist. The teacher says that she should have been given sufficient training to reduce her rate of transformation as long as she keeps a clear head. The student has already panicked, and says that it's impossible.

On the next page/stage of transformation:

The two have headed deeper into the zone. The teacher comments that the corruptive energies are getting stronger, and that even her own magical defences are starting to be worn down. The teacher has started to be more significantly transformed, and her arms and legs are starting to be reduced and cease to look like arms and legs. Due to the teacher's stronger magical abilities, her transformation is starting to treat her physical abilities as unimportant, and her transformation reflects this.

The student has become more monstrous, and appears to be the more physically powerful one of the two. She however still has her anxious personality and expression, and asks how much longer it's going to take, and that she doesn't even look human anymore.

In the third page, the two have reached the most extreme points of their transformations. Even the teacher has reached a completely inhuman form, save for her face resembling a human's.

By this point, the teacher has completely lost the use of her limbs, although she may have had them replaced with something else if you choose so. By this point, you could also have it be that she is either floating magically, or needs to be carried by her student. It is up to you.

The student, after her transformation has advanced so far, has started to become mentally affected and no longer worries about her transformation. 

(Please feel free to alter the dialogue and treat this as a guideline if you think something else would work better:)

The student says: "I think I can see the goal, master! But I'm really starting to feel good, better than when I was just a human. Do we really need to destroy it? I think we're fine the way we are..."

The teacher responds: "Unbelievable! To think that a student of mine's mind has been corrupted. After we destroy the cursed object and get out of here, you'll be undergoing extra special training!"

Since the transformation has been fully depicted by this point, anything past this point is purely optional to draw. Thank you very much for reading this far.

If you're willing to draw one extra page (it can be lower detail than the others):

We see the two after they've destroyed the object and dispelled the cursed zone. The teacher has already been able to dispel 50% of her transformation, regaining her arms and undoing some of the other changes to her body and face. However, the student has regained her senses, but has been unable to restore her body to normal.

The student begs her teacher to help change her back to normal, but the teacher states that as punishment for her lack of training, she'll be remaining in her monstrous form for the time being, and this will teach her to not let her transformations get so advanced next time. The teacher privately thinks to herself that her student is actually very talented, but she'll never get anywhere as long as she keeps losing her composure.

Thank you once again! I hope I haven't asked for anything too unreasonable!

こんにちは、あなたのアートワークとモンスターのデザインが好きです。この漫画の依頼を検討してもらえると嬉しいです。
背景：
玄界灘では一夜にして皆の下半身が消えてしまった。まるで腰から切られて下半身が持っていかれたかのように。しかし、下半身がないだけで、上半身は普通に生きている。
ストーリー
朝目覚めた霊夢は、スカートとストッキングを履こうとするが、下半身がないことに気づく。不器用な彼女はゆかりを訪ね、何があったのか尋ねる。
ゆかりは何が起こっているのかわからないが、「解決策を見つけた」と宣言する。ゆかりは境界線を操作することで、ランダムな4本足の動物の下半身と人の上半身をつなげる。その結果、皆の人生はめちゃくちゃになった。
霊夢の下半身は熊、上半身は変化なし。4本の巨大な足のために、ストッキングとドレスを着ようとしている。ゆかりとこいしは、新しい下半身で霊夢の神社にお参りにやってくる。
以下のストーリーを3〜4ページでデザインしてください。
